subject: TechElevate 2026 — activation scope, stage time & logo placement
messages:
From: Lauren Park <lauren@techelevate.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@eventsinc.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TechElevate 2026 — sponsor package and draft SOW

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — excited that Redwood is interested in a Platinum+ activation at TechElevate (Oct 12-14, SF). Attached is the draft SOW and the current floor plan. Quick highlights from our side:

- Platinum+ includes: 20x20 island, logo on main stage scrim, one 45-min keynote OR two 30-min breakout sessions (your choice), 5000-email attendee opt-in list (hashed), 10 VIP dinner invites, and one 60-min invite-only roundtable.
- Prime logo placement on the main stage is allocated to the lead Platinum sponsor; co-Platinum logos are resized down one tier.
- Dedicated demo pod in the activation alley (5x3) and one complimentary 6ft table in the partner lounge.
- Lead capture is available via onsite scanners — we'll provide lead files 72 hours after the event.

We left a couple of things intentionally flexible (keynote vs breakouts, roundtable size). Can you confirm: 1) whether you want main stage priority or the keynote slot, and 2) how many staff will require exhibitor badges?

Attached: TechElevate_Sponsor_SOW_v2.pdf, booth_map_A3.png

Lauren Park
Director, Sponsorships
TechElevate
lauren@techelevate.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Park <lauren@techelevate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TechElevate 2026 — sponsor package and draft SOW

Hi Lauren — thanks for sending this so quickly. A few clarifying questions before we push this through procurement: 

1) Main stage vs breakout: We prioritize visibility but need a guaranteed 30–45 minute speaking window on a main stage to support product narrative. Would TechElevate consider guaranteeing a 30-min main stage slot (25 min talk + 5 min moderated Q&A) in exchange for us dropping the roundtable from the Platinum+ deliverables?

2) Logo treatments: Can you confirm exact placement dimensions for the stage scrim (px on the artwork spec) and whether Redwood will have top-line priority on the event website home banner for the week of the conference? We see the current SOW says "prime placement" but that is ambiguous for co-Platinum.

3) Lead list & data: Need confirmation that the attendee list will be hashed and that any PII will be handled per our SOC2 policy. Also request a sample lead file format so our CS can validate ingestion.

4) Activation logistics: We want the demo pod near the partner lounge (not at far end of alley); is that movable on the floor plan? If not, we'll request a second small standing table closer to partner traffic.

5) Badges: Initial headcount is 6 exhibitor badges, plus 2 VIP dinner seats. We may scale to 8 depending on staffing.

If you can mark up the SOW with logo dims and an explicit stage time guarantee, we can route to finance and legal. Also curious about priority for a post-event 1:1 intro list — is that included in the "VIP dinner" or separate?

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: TechElevate 2026 — sponsor package and draft SOW

FW: Lauren sent the SOW — want quick internal align on what we push for and what we can trade off. Key asks from my side: guaranteed 30-min main stage (or elevated breakout + homepage banner), exact logo dims, lead hashing/format, and demo pod location.

Notes and proposed negotiation moves below (see attached proposed_activation_swap_table.xlsx):

- Marcus: push for guaranteed 30-min main stage slot; we can drop roundtable and trade 2 of our VIP dinner seats to them. The main stage is the most visible for product narrative (and press).
- Marissa: prioritize homepage banner during the week of (Mon-Fri) — ask that the banner also appear in the mobile app top banner; if they won't guarantee it, ask for dedicated feature in event mobile app + 1 push notification.
- Tessa: logistics — confirm we get early load-in for island build and 8 exhibitor badges; also negotiate for two complimentary hotel rooms for keynote speaker night.

Can everyone reply with redlines by EOD so I can send consolidated asks to Lauren tomorrow morning.

—Naomi

From: Lauren Park <lauren@techelevate.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@eventsinc.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TechElevate 2026 — sponsor package and draft SOW

Hi Naomi — appreciate the clear list. We can accommodate most of this with the following adjustments: 

- Main stage: We can offer a guaranteed 30-min main stage slot (25 + 5 Q&A) if Redwood agrees to remove the 60-min roundtable from the Platinum+ package. In lieu of the roundtable, we will provide a 45-person closed VIP breakfast (hosted by you) with 20 curated intro emails post-event.
- Logo: We'll provide exact artwork specs (1000px x 300px for the home banner; stage scrim master is 3840px x 1080px — Redwood logo will occupy up to 15% width in a co-Platinum lockup). We'll attach an artwork spec and a sample mockup to sign-off.
- Lead data: Attendee list will be hashed; PII is not included. Raw lead capture from scanners will be available 72 hours post-event in CSV; sample file attached. We are SOC2-compliant for data handoffs and will sign an NDA addendum if needed.
- Demo pod: We can move the demo pod to the partner lounge perimeter (closer to foot traffic) — updated floor plan attached.
- Badges & rooms: We'll confirm 8 exhibitor badges and two comp hotel nights covering the keynote speaker date.

If that works, I'll send a redlined SOW with the stage guarantee and logo dims. We can also give you a discounted rate on the sponsored afterparty if that is of interest (10% off the add-on).

Best,
Lauren

On Fri, Jul 3, 2026 at 09:27 Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Lauren — will review internally and revert by EOD.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Park <lauren@techelevate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TechElevate 2026 — sponsor package and draft SOW

Lauren — thanks for the updates and the rapid turnaround. We are prepared to accept the revised trade: guaranteed 30-min main stage slot (25 + 5 Q&A), move of demo pod to partner lounge perimeter, 8 exhibitor badges, two comp hotel nights, and the 45-person VIP breakfast + 20 curated post-event intros in exchange for removing the 60-min roundtable. Please confirm the following before I sign and route to procurement/legal: 

1) Please add the logo artwork specs and stage scrim dims directly into the SOW (so legal has a hard deliverable).
2) Please include the clause that the attendee lead files will be hashed and delivered in UTF-8 CSV with field mapping (email_hash, company, title, lead_score).
3) Add a clause: "Priority homepage banner to be displayed Monday 00:00 PDT through Friday 23:59 PDT of event week." If mobile app banner is included, please specify timing for the push notification.
4) Include a standard data protection addendum referencing our SOC2 controls; we will countersign.

If you can send the updated redline (DocuSign preferred) I will initial and forward to finance for invoice and to legal for the DPA. Attaching our internal proposed_activation_swap_table.xlsx for your records.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to lock this.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: proposed_activation_swap_table.xlsx
